verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm with a client platform (case dashboard, task lists, attorney messaging). A software platform of this kind could plausibly offer workflow automations, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-defined automations, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of them. Attorney review of filings is a different capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
